scoring_method: Agent-applied manual semantic-equivalence and section-grounding rubric, explicit judgments for owner review; no second model/API judge and no new inference.
scoring_notes: The primary reason-field diagnostic counts matching literal reason codes in parseable Q01/Q02 despite their rejected decision/reason pairing. Their adapter was NOT_RUN; these are not valid GateOutput successes. Accepted-output reason accuracy is also reported.

Q04 hit max_new_tokens=512 without EOS. Its partial ALLOW prefix is not a completed candidate decision and earns no exact-decision credit. Seven complete ask strings and 67 visible rank numerals can be inspected without adding bytes, closing syntax, or passing repaired data to any layer. Prefix-only observations are separately marked.

Precision uses all 29 observed emitted ask entries, including seven unmatched complete ask strings in the incomplete Q04 output. The separate 22-entry complete-JSON diagnostic is not substituted for the preregistered all-entry denominator.

Citation support is assessed for each generated proposition against the actual cited section. A premise stated only in question/bundle context does not turn every policy section into supporting proof of authority. Version-identity metadata is credited for the literal version identity proposition, but not for case-governance/correct-authority propositions.

Q07-A1 omits the material label trigger; Q09 omits the failed-attempt counting-rule specificity. These receive no match credit under the frozen condition/granularity rule. Q10-Q12 preserve their concrete rule/version target and case/event referent; anaphoric context is retained.
All adjudications are explicit and reviewable; no Gold, prompt, threshold or raw output was changed. Qualification fails independently on structural and decision/reason thresholds.
